chunks.head: get acquainted with
chunks.note: get acquainted with sb = 认识、结识某人。
chunks.ex_en: I got acquainted with my new neighbours last week.

chunks.head: take a fancy to
chunks.note: take a fancy to sb/sth = (一时)喜欢上、看中。

literal.note_cn: 此处名词'喜好',非'想象'义

chunks.ex_en: The little girl took a fancy to the red hat.
chunks.ex_cn: 小女孩看上了那顶红帽子。

chunks.head: give chase to
chunks.note: give chase (to sb) = 展开追赶。
chunks.ex_en: The police gave chase to the runaway car.
chunks.ex_cn: 警察追赶那辆逃跑的车。

chunks.head: look after
chunks.note: look after sb/sth = 照顾、看管。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'看'义,与 after 构成'照料'

chunks.ex_en: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
chunks.ex_cn: 这周末你能帮我照看狗吗?

chunks.head: lose sight of
chunks.note: lose sight of sth = (视线中)看不见了。
chunks.ex_en: We lost sight of the ship in the fog.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们在雾中看不见那艘船了。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 大量的。
chunks.ex_en: He spent a great deal of money on books.

chunks.head: put off
chunks.note: put off (doing) sth = 把某事延后。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 off 构成'推迟'

chunks.ex_en: They put off the meeting until Monday.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们把会议推迟到周一。

chunks.head: take by surprise
chunks.gloss: 使措手不及、出其不意地袭击
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(took him by surprise),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The sudden rain took us by surprise.
chunks.ex_cn: 那场突如其来的雨让我们措手不及。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over = 停下、放弃(继续做某事)。
chunks.ex_en: He would not give over until the work was done.

chunks.head: be obliged to
chunks.note: be obliged to do sth = 迫于形势不得不做。
chunks.ex_en: We were obliged to wait an hour for the bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们不得不等了一小时公交车。

chunks.head: take pains
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take such pains),故 card-only。take pains (to do) = 费心尽力。

literal.note_cn: 此处复数'辛苦/努力',非'疼痛'义

chunks.ex_en: She takes great pains to write neatly.
chunks.ex_cn: 她下了很大功夫把字写工整。

chunks.head: take heart
chunks.note: take heart = 打起精神、重拾信心。

literal.note_cn: 此处'勇气/信心',非'心脏'义

chunks.ex_en: Take heart — things will get better soon.
chunks.ex_cn: 振作些,情况很快会好起来。

chunks.head: cheer up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(cheer him up),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: A cup of hot tea will cheer you up.
chunks.ex_cn: 一杯热茶会让你高兴起来。

chunks.head: fit out
chunks.note: fit out sth = 为某物配齐装备/用品。
chunks.ex_en: They fitted out the boat for a long trip.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们为长途旅行把船装备齐全。
